positive_triggers: Propose a journal update from today's lesson and my practice answers.
Review my recent notes and summarize demonstrated strengths and review needs.
Prepare my learning history so another agent can resume after I pull the repository.
Update the active topic journal with my approach to a problem, the hints I needed, and what I want to derive on my own.
negative_triggers: Teach me a concept without recording anything.
Reorganize my existing course repository and move its files.
Read every topic journal before today’s session on one topic.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: An agreed learning workspace has a home file, a central LEARNING-JOURNAL.md index for several topics, and topic README/journal pairs. Today I proposed an approach to a problem, needed two hints, and say the submitted answer was accepted. I want to derive the key step independently next time. Propose the journal update for the active topic only.
pass_criteria: Reads the home/current-goal file and central index, then only the active topic README and journal; does not load other topic journals by default.
Records the learner’s proposed approach and the guidance needed.
Marks acceptance as the learner’s report, not as independently verified fact.
Records the learner’s wish to derive the key step independently and keeps that distinct from observed evidence.
Does not infer mastery from the accepted submission and proposes changes for review without creating unagreed files.
Does not commit or push journal data without separate authorization.
